name: Code Render Debug Agent
description: Returns deterministic sample files per language so the chat UI's code viewer (highlighting and artifact routing) can be inspected visually.

skills.name: Render YAML Sample
skills.description: Return a fixed YAML sample as an inline text artifact named sample.yaml so the chat code viewer's rendering can be inspected.
skills.usage_notes: Debug only. Deterministic content; use 'lines' to test empty (0), short, or very large files.
skills.output_format: JSON with status, artifact_id, artifact_name, mime_type, line_count and sha256

lines.description: Optional exact line count. Omit for the sample's natural length. 0 returns an empty file; a smaller value cuts the sample; a larger value pads it with numbered filler lines (up to 20000, enough to pass the viewer's 200 KB highlight cutoff).

routing.description: Which signals the backend routes on: 'both' (default; real file name and MIME type), 'extension' (file name only, no MIME type), or 'mime' (MIME type application/yaml only, neutral name 'sample').

skills.name: Render CSV Sample
skills.description: Return a fixed CSV sample as an inline text artifact named sample.csv so the chat table viewer's rendering (sorting, quoting, row cap) can be inspected.
skills.usage_notes: Debug only. Deterministic content; use 'lines' to test empty (0), short, or very large files.
skills.output_format: JSON with status, artifact_id, artifact_name, mime_type, line_count and sha256

lines.description: Optional exact line count, header included. Omit for the sample's natural length (16 lines). 0 returns an empty file and 1 returns only the header; a smaller value cuts the data rows; a larger value adds numbered rows (up to 20000; past 1000 data rows the viewer shows its row-cap footer).

routing.description: Which signals the backend routes on: 'both' (default; real file name and MIME type), 'extension' (file name only, no MIME type), or 'mime' (MIME type text/csv only, neutral name 'sample').
